subject: 1093年大理国大理王府段氏宫室（建筑细部待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE isolated 2:1 dimetric city-map building sprite for a historical wuxia game, Dali kingdom in 1093. This is a map sprite NOT an illustration scene. Use supplied image only as matching material and 45-degree MAP CAMERA reference. Orthographic yaw 45 degrees, camera elevation 30 degrees. The two horizontal ground axes on the screen MUST slope +0.5 and -0.5 exactly (one pixel rise per two pixels run). South entrance faces LOWER LEFT. Vertical posts stay vertical. Thin rectangular ground footprint with visible front/left/right corners, no thick plinth. Centered whole sprite with at least10% empty transparent padding on all sides. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, absolutely NO mountains, sky, horizon, trees outside the footprint, gradient backdrop, ambient halo or ground outside rectangle. Realistic weathered gray tiles, dark timber, pale earth plaster and dull stone matching reference material, restrained Song-period silhouette. Light from screen UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow toward LOWER RIGHT. NO WRITING AT ALL, no banners/boards with characters, no people, no modern objects, no logos, no border, no watermark, no tourism-era decoration. A Dali Duan clan royal residence module, modest but dignified palace courtyard. One broad rear timber reception hall on shallow stone steps, paired small side wings, low plain enclosure and south entrance pavilion. Dark gray restrained hipped roofs, faded vermilion posts, light earth-colored walls, subtle small lotus relief at doorway without lettering. Sparse camellia within court. No golden Forbidden City roofs, no fantasy or monumental modern reconstruction. Footprint 18m east-west by14m north-south.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚底座、旅游古城风格、裁切、透视汇聚

references.role: 本批候选相机与材质参考（非作者approved）
